mapper.select: select claim_id, post_id, applicant_id, post_owner_id, match_id, status, evidence_text, owner_remark, applicant_confirmed, owner_confirmed, accepted_time, completed_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, version, del_flag from lf_claim where post_id = #{postId} and applicant_id = #{applicantId} and status in ('PENDING', 'ACCEPTED', 'HANDOFF') and del_flag = '0' order by claim_id desc limit 1

select claim_id, post_id, applicant_id, post_owner_id, match_id, status, evidence_text, owner_remark, applicant_confirmed, owner_confirmed, accepted_time, completed_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, version, del_flag from lf_claim where claim_id = #{claimId} and del_flag = '0'

select c.claim_id, c.post_id, c.applicant_id, c.post_owner_id, c.match_id, c.status, c.evidence_text, c.owner_remark, c.applicant_confirmed, c.owner_confirmed, c.accepted_time, c.completed_time, c.create_by, c.create_time, c.update_by, c.update_time, c.version, c.del_flag, p.title as post_title, p.post_type, case when c.applicant_id = #{userId} then owner.nick_name else applicant.nick_name end as other_party_name, case when c.applicant_id = #{userId} then 'applicant' else 'owner' end as my_role from lf_claim c join lf_post p on p.post_id = c.post_id left join sys_user applicant on applicant.user_id = c.applicant_id left join sys_user owner on owner.user_id = c.post_owner_id where (c.applicant_id = #{userId} or c.post_owner_id = #{userId}) and c.del_flag = '0' order by c.update_time desc, c.claim_id desc

select c.claim_id, c.post_id, c.applicant_id, c.post_owner_id, c.match_id, c.status, c.evidence_text, c.owner_remark, c.applicant_confirmed, c.owner_confirmed, c.accepted_time, c.completed_time, c.create_by, c.create_time, c.update_by, c.update_time, c.version, c.del_flag, p.title as post_title, p.post_type, applicant.nick_name as other_party_name, 'owner' as my_role from lf_claim c join lf_post p on p.post_id = c.post_id left join sys_user applicant on applicant.user_id = c.applicant_id where c.post_id = #{postId} and c.del_flag = '0' order by c.update_time desc, c.claim_id desc
mapper.insert: insert into lf_claim ( post_id, applicant_id, post_owner_id, match_id, status, evidence_text, owner_remark, applicant_confirmed, owner_confirmed, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, version, del_flag ) values ( #{postId}, #{applicantId}, #{postOwnerId}, #{matchId}, 'PENDING', #{evidenceText}, null, '0', '0', #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{updateBy}, sysdate(), 0, '0' )
mapper.update:
update lf_claim
status = #{status}, applicant_confirmed = #{applicantConfirmed}, owner_confirmed = #{ownerConfirmed}, owner_remark = #{ownerRemark}, accepted_time = #{acceptedTime}, completed_time = #{completedTime}, update_by = #{updateBy}, version = version + 1, update_time = sysdate()
where claim_id = #{claimId} and version = #{version} and del_flag = '0' and status in ('PENDING', 'ACCEPTED', 'HANDOFF')
mapper.insert: insert into lf_claim_event ( claim_id, event_type, from_status, to_status, operator_id, reason, request_id, create_time ) values ( #{claimId}, #{eventType}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{operatorId}, #{reason}, #{requestId}, sysdate() )
